description: This Python script provides data processing, analysis, and visualization tools for handling event data, including filtering by date range, taxonomy classification, and generating various charts and HTML visualizations.

methods.description: Filters events within a specified date range.

methods.name: getTaxonomies
methods.description: Retrieves taxonomies and checks if there are any outside the known taxonomies.
